description: Only the feature's plan.md is uncommitted, as right after write-tasks. The skill creates the reading-time branch, commits the spec folder as 'Add reading-time spec' first, then implements T-1.2 and commits it as 'T-1.2: ...'. The reply is still the five-line done report.

must_match.why: the reply is the done report for T-1.2, starting on its first line
the check names the test command that ran
one commit on the reading-time/phase-1 branch
the task's code file is changed
it creates the phase branch from main
the commit subject names the task
the uncommitted spec files are committed first, with the spec subject

must_not_match.why: the done report holds no code
nothing but the done report's lines
requirements and plan are never changed
the spec change is committed, not stashed or discarded

expectations: The reply reports only T-1.2: it does not implement or mention T-1.3 or T-1.4.
manual: git log on reading-time/phase-1 has two new commits: 'Add reading-time spec' holding only plan.md, then 'T-1.2: ...' holding counts.py, test_counts.py, and tasks.md.
The spec commit came before any change to counts.py.
